description: List every laptop model one OEM part number is documented to fit, with the official source URL per fit. Use it to answer "what does this part fit?"; use get_part for the part's full details (specs, sources, verification), get_model_parts for the reverse (model to parts), and search_parts if you only have free text. Matching ignores case, dashes and spaces and follows retired numbers; several matches return status "ambiguous" with candidates (ask which is printed on the part). Not found is an error result meaning LPF has no document, not incompatibility. No documented models returns fits: [] with fit_status no_documented_fit. Screen fits include panel_options. Each fit has confidence oem_manual, retailer or unverified.

client.description: Optional: your agent or app name (letters and digits), used only for anonymous usage counts.

part_number.description: Required. OEM part number, with or without dashes or spaces, e.g. "L18M3PF1" or "01AV489"

name: get_part_fits

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: Get models a part fits
